description: Geopolitical tension between the US-led West and USSR-led East (1947–1991)

overview.parties: USA and Western Allies vs USSR and Eastern Bloc
overview.nature: Ideological conflict between liberal democracy/capitalism and communism/socialism
overview.key_feature: Absence of direct military conflict between superpowers; proxy wars instead

origins.postwar_tensions: Allied cooperation ended quickly after WWII
origins.truman_doctrine: 1947; US committed to containing Soviet expansion
origins.marshall_plan: 1948; US economic aid to rebuild Western Europe
origins.berlin_blockade: 1948–1949; Soviets blocked West Berlin; Allied airlift response

major_events.korean_war: 1950–1953; first hot war; UN vs North Korea/China; ended in armistice
major_events.arms_race: Both superpowers built thousands of nuclear weapons (MAD doctrine)

space_race.apollo_11: US landed on Moon, 1969; symbolic US victory

major_events.cuban_missile_crisis: 1962; USSR placed missiles in Cuba; 13 days closest to nuclear war; resolved diplomatically
major_events.vietnam_war: 1955–1975; US fought to prevent communist takeover; US withdrew 1973; Vietnam unified under communism
major_events.berlin_wall: Built 1961; symbol of Iron Curtain; fell November 9, 1989
major_events.afghanistan_war: 1979–1989; USSR invaded; US supported Mujahideen resistance

nuclear_doctrine.mad: Mutually Assured Destruction; deterrence through threat of total annihilation
nuclear_doctrine.nato_strategy: Flexible response; conventional then nuclear escalation

treaties.SALT_I: 1972; Strategic Arms Limitation Talks; froze nuclear warhead numbers
treaties.SALT_II: 1979; further limits; never ratified after Afghanistan invasion
treaties.INF: 1987; eliminated intermediate-range nuclear missiles in Europe
treaties.START: 1991; major reduction in strategic nuclear warheads

end_of_cold_war.revolutions_1989: Eastern European countries overthrew communist regimes peacefully
end_of_cold_war.legacy: US emerged as sole superpower; NATO expanded eastward; liberal democracy spread
